poses.caption: Stand sideways to a high pulley, holding the handle with the nearer arm. Keep the upper arm against your side and bend the elbow.
Extend the elbow to press the handle beside your thigh. Keep the upper arm still, return slowly, and repeat on both sides.

jobs.prompt: Use case scientific-educational. Original premium ADULT male anatomical exercise illustration canonical1609 CABLE ONE ARM SIDE TRICEPS PUSHDOWN. TWO equal square cells side by side WIDE2:1 landscape. SAME full body person equipment camera scale in each. Stand SIDEWAYS to cable tower: tower on viewerLEFT, working arm nearest tower. Three-quarter FRONT view clearly shows working elbow and triceps. High pulley above head with SINGLE taut cable descending to small D handle gripped by nearest hand. Torso tall stationary feet flat shoulder width. Working upper arm VERTICAL pressed alongside ribs in BOTH poses. LEFT START elbow bent90degrees forearm forward horizontal hand at waist, neutral wrist. RIGHT FINISH elbow extends until working arm straight hand beside thigh, same upper arm and elbow location. Cable and handle remain continuously visibly connected and taut in both cells. Other arm rests naturally away from cable. No torso lean or shoulder movement. Primary working TRICEPS red on exposed posterior upper arm ONLY, no chest/biceps/forearm red. Detailed grayscale anatomical exposed skin, realistic two arms hands five fingers, consistent proportions. Full opaque solid BLACK tank wraps chest sides back; BLACK mid-thigh shorts fully cover front sides back seat crotch with intact seams hems. NO clothing cutaways transparency or muscle fibers through cloth. Black shoes. Entire body hands feet tower pulley and base fit each cell with10percent margins pure WHITE background soft shadows. Reference original artwork STYLE ONLY ignore its pose/chest red. Equivalent male/female detailed quality. No labels letters text arrows captions or extra people.
jobs.inspectionNote: Two cable one-arm side pushdown candidates, four poses, two built-in calls. Real outputs inspected: male nearer arm bends to extension with taut cable and red exposed triceps. Female uses farther arm across torso and is BLOCKED for canonical side/arm mismatch. Opaque tank and shorts retained; hands, elbow stability, cable geometry and triceps mapping need qualified human review. Original artwork style only, no upstream media. Exact prompts and masters retained. No anatomical approval or publication.
